players.product: gas-insulated switchgear (GIS), MV switchboards, vacuum circuit breakers and protection-relay panels

quarterly_data.signal: Customer Korea National Railway: Seondo Electric signed two contracts to manufacture and install 72.5kV gas-insulated switchgear (GIS), KRW 6,188 million in total, about 16% of 2025 revenue: the Honam High-Speed Railway Phase 2 (Gomakwon-Mokpo) substation 72.5kV GIS (KRW 4,350 million) and an expansion of 72.5kV GIS at the Honam High-Speed Railway Iksan electric-railway substation (KRW 1,838 million). The company says it won the Gomakwon-Mokpo contract in a competitive bid among 10 companies including large companies. It previously supplied 29kV GIS for electric railways to national railway substations (Wonju-Gangneung line, Donghae line) and now extends to 72.5kV GIS for high-speed railway substations.
quarterly_data.figure: KRW 6,188 million in two contracts (KRW 4,350 million + KRW 1,838 million), about 16% of 2025 revenue

quarterly_data.signal: Plan: with a protection-relay panel lineup able to handle up to 765kV (Korea's highest transmission voltage) combined with its 72.5kV GIS, the company says it can supply integrated transmission and substation equipment, and plans to expand into markets with rising high-voltage demand - grid expansion, renewable-energy grid connection and large industrial complexes. CEO Kwon Hyuk: the company will actively expand supply of extra-high-voltage products to future power infrastructure such as transmission, substations and renewable energy.
